page_title: NAP 1-1 TOR | Napoli v Torino 08/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Daniele Orsato is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
90+3' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
90+3' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) takes the corner with a short pass.
90+2' Substitution. Stanislav Lobotka will be replaced by Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli).
90+2' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the top of the net, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Vanja Milinkovic-Savic.
90+1' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli).
90+1' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) is able to continue to play.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
88' Karol Linetty goes off the pitch and Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) comes on.
87' The substitution has been made. Valentino Lazaro (Torino) has replaced Raoul Bellanova.
87' The resulting corner from Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
86' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

86' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
86' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
84' Leo Ostigard (Napoli) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
84' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
79' Francesco Calzona has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mathias Olivera (Napoli) replacing Mario Rui.

78' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the bottom right corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
78' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) takes the corner.

77' He should have scored! Victor Osimhen (Napoli) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot aimed inside the right post is pretty weak and Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes an easy save.
77' The corner from Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) is hurriedly cleared.
77' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Napoli.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Saba Sazonov (Torino) is coming onto the pitch as Koffi Djidji cannot continue after picking up an injury.

76' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
75' The game is interrupted now, Koffi Djidji (Torino) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
74' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
71' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
71' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Napoli earn a corner.
70' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
70' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
69' Duvan Zapata (Torino) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniele Orsato blows for a foul.
68' That's the end of the game for Piotr Zielinski, who is replaced by Hamed Junior Traore (Napoli).
67' Here is a change. Matteo Politano is going off and Francesco Calzona gives the last tactical orders to Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli).
64' 1 - 1 GOAL! Antonio Sanabria (Torino) gets to the rebound inside the box and fires in a stunning overhead kick. Phenomenal finish! 1:1.
64' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) prepares to take a corner kick.

64' Duvan Zapata (Torino) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball goes behind for a corner. Torino will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
63' It is time for a substitution. Antonio Sanabria (Torino) is on for Pietro Pellegri.
61' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Mario Rui laid the ball off to Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.

60' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
59' The game is interrupted as Victor Osimhen (Napoli) is flagged offside.
58' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
57' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
55' Duvan Zapata (Torino) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
55' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) will take a corner kick.
55' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Torino comes to nothing. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Torino.
53' Matteo Politano (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
51' Matteo Politano (Napoli) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
50' Matteo Politano (Napoli) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
48' Matteo Politano (Napoli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
47' Matteo Politano (Napoli) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
45+3' Daniele Orsato shows a yellow card to Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) for his blatant foul.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Matteo Politano (Napoli).

43' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the bottom right corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is prepared and dives to thwart him. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
41' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the left post. What a chance!
41' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Torino.
39' Juan Jesus (Napoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Orsato had an easy-decision to make.
36' Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
36' Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
36' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
35' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
34' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
32' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' Duvan Zapata (Torino) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
31' Dangerous play by Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli). Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for a foul.
29' The resulting set piece from Torino is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
29' A dangerous towering header by Duvan Zapata (Torino) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
28' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Torino.
27' Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) makes a strong challenge and Daniele Orsato blows for a foul.
26' Matteo Politano (Napoli) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
24' The game is interrupted now, Matteo Politano (Napoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
24' A flowing move ends with a great cross into the centre of the box, which Victor Osimhen (Napoli) latches onto but sends a wild header well wide of the right post.
23' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
20' A lofted cross from Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
19' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
16' Matteo Politano (Napoli) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

15' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Napoli win a corner.
14' The corner is swung in but Torino can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
12' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alex Meret intercepts the ball.
10' Matteo Politano (Napoli) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
10' Matteo Politano (Napoli) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Napoli force a corner. They send men into the box.
10' Napoli are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
7' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' One of the defending players blocks a long-range shot which was unleashed by Matteo Politano (Napoli).
4' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
3' Daniele Orsato blows his whistle. Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) commits a foul after dangerous play.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Napoli will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Daniele Orsato.
